subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should `question.*`, `operator.questions`, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` become the permanent public provider-neutral question contract in this release?
rationale: The PR adds a broad Gateway and plugin API contract spanning core, three channels, web UI, and native clients; tests can validate implementation but cannot choose the long-term public boundary or compatibility commitment.

options.title: Stabilize the public contract
options.body: Keep the proposed architecture, repair the blocking boundaries, add current-head proof, and approve the new methods, events, scope, and SDK subpath as supported API.

options.title: Keep resolution internal first
options.body: Land the core question runtime without exporting the plugin SDK resolver until the channel interaction contract has matured.

options.title: Pause the broad surface
options.body: Defer this PR and split a narrower Gateway and Control UI foundation from channel and public SDK integration.

recommendation.title: Stabilize the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed architecture, repair the blocking boundaries, add current-head proof, and approve the new methods, events, scope, and SDK subpath as supported API.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged question-card work and recent protocol history make them the strongest available owner for the permanent contract choice.
